svg.title: How the layered render works
svg.desc: The React composition produces two things: a framing plan in JSON and a graphics layer rendered by Chrome as PNG with alpha. The footage is decoded by NVDEC through Vulkan Video, cropped and placed by libplacebo with per-frame expressions from the plan, blended with the graphics, encoded by NVENC and written as MP4.
svg.text: One React composition, two outputs. The footage never enters the browser.
CPU seconds for 15 s of video R, N=3. Remotion alone, same frames: 221.8 s.
